visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed rotating banner (6 slides, arrows + autoplay). Background image per slide, left-aligned heading, description and pill CTA(s). Optional second picture per slide is used as the mobile banner.
contentPattern: One row per slide. Cell 1: picture (desktop) + optional second picture (mobile). Cell 2: heading (title), optional paragraph(s) (summary), 1-2 links (primary and secondary CTA). Optional headless source: leading 2-cell config rows 'Fonte'/'Source' (persisted query URL, must be the first row), 'Público'/'Audience', 'Escopo Target'/'Target scope'; they are removed and the remaining authored rows become the fallback.

cfMapping.resumo: paragraph(s) of cell 2 (resumo.plaintext or string; blank lines split paragraphs)
cfMapping.imagem: cell 1, first picture (desktop); _dynamicUrl (Dynamic Media, width/preferwebp params) > _publishUrl > _path, relative values prefixed with the query host
cfMapping.ctaTexto/ctaLink: first link (primary CTA); only http(s) or site-relative hrefs
cfMapping.ativoDe/ativoAte: slide shown only between these dates when present (date-only ativoAte is inclusive)

usage: Home page hero rotating promotional banners (Imoveis a venda, App Copel, Copel Agro, Seguro Protege, Copel investe, Leilao federal).
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width rotating promotional banners where each slide has an image, title, optional summary and up to two CTAs. Keep the 2-cell row structure stable: it is the contract for feeding slides from AEM headless banner Content Fragments. Slides without summary are supported; a single slide renders without navigation.

configRows.value: Persisted query URL, absolute or relative to config.json aem-publish-url (e.g. /graphql/execute.json/copel/banners-por-canal;canal=site). Must be the first row.
Sent as the ;publico= query variable when the URL does not set it.
Adobe Target decision scope. With window.alloy, the decided {"bannerPath"} moves that banner first (fetched with copel/banner-por-path when not in the list) and a propositionDisplay event is sent.

headlessSource.fallback: Authored rows render immediately and stay when the fetch fails, times out (4s), returns no active items or the URL is missing. Without authored rows a hero-height skeleton is shown, and the block is hidden if no banners arrive.
